$comment: Platforms indexed as a single entry each, never as trust seeds: their merchants are not individually reviewed. Product-level indexing is not enabled. Clients must enforce allowedTools as an allowlist (any unlisted tool, including ones added later, is denied) and hand checkout to the owner via continue_url.

platforms.name: Shop (Shopify) MCP
platforms.toolPolicy: allowlist: any tool not listed is denied, including tools the platform adds later.

explicitlyDenied.complete_checkout: Shop Pay pays with saved cards after sign-in, bypassing plugin spending limits
explicitlyDenied.create_spend_request|get_spend_request|u: can release card credentials to the agent; highest-severity risk if the agent is injected
